reviewMethod: Individually displayed all eight original PNGs with view_image; no image edits. Findings are manual visual observations, separate from the capture DOM measurements.
findings: Desktop dialog and dropdown are fully visible in light and dark themes; no observed clipped labels or overlapping controls.
Mobile dialog wraps the execution target and Profile controls into two rows; input text wraps within the card, close and Create controls remain visible.
Checking state is presented as neutral status text; the selected checking option is clearly marked and the Create control is visibly active.
Disabled and enabled-but-no-model entries are visually muted and distinguish their respective reasons; actual disabled semantics are recorded separately by the capture DOM receipt.
Menu may cover part of the underlying dialog, as expected for an open dropdown; all menu entries and management action stay within the viewport.
No credentials, private Profile instructions, raw native session identifiers, or unrelated production task content are visible in these isolated images.
limitations: These are isolated Docker production-build pages at 77b, not live production or native subscription execution evidence.
A screenshot alone cannot prove server admission, successful task dispatch or provider availability.
Any later-head reuse requires unchanged UI/dependency proof; the image source commit remains 77b.
